answer: Standing decays on a fixed clock. Each epoch with no filed work removes a slice of reputation, and the slice widens the longer the identity idles. Attestations clustered on one subnet are taxed at payout, so a farm vouching across its own reef of accounts collects a fraction of face value. Rebuilding a decayed score costs whole epochs of real work, which is the bridge an attacker cannot skip. Reputation here is grown timber, not bought.
